SMTO-JOB-0007 — The Gateway's reply didn't match the job SMTO asked about

GUID: a50d6c4e-7395-4c56-b8de-21e2cb4faa74
Slug: job-response-correlation-invalid
Domain: JOB · Subsystem: job

What happened

  • SMTO asked the Gateway about a job, but the reply was about a different job or wasn't readable. SMTO set it aside so it wouldn't mix up results.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Setup › Gateways and check that the Gateway this task uses is connected and is the computer where the job was started. A reply from a different or reinstalled Gateway won't know about this job.
  2. Ask SMTO in the conversation to check the status of the earlier job again. Don't ask it to start the job again. Checking again gets a fresh reply; starting the job again could repeat its work.
  3. If the Gateway was recently reinstalled or updated, select Check for updates on the same screen. SMTO and the Gateway need matching versions to understand each other's replies.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows the status and output for the right job.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages the Gateway. Don't treat any output shown with this message as the job's result.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Gateway returned job logs or state with a different job_id, invalid text or an unsupported job state for the correlated request.

What this means

  • Job logs/state returned by the Gateway have a different job_id, invalid text type or unsupported job state. Job identity, supervision and dispatch/terminal receipts own effect truth. Diagnostics do not launch, cancel or replay work; missing output or failed control does not prove that the original process stopped.

Why this can happen

  • Job logs/state returned by the Gateway have a different job_id, invalid text type or unsupported job state.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the exact requested ID and response contract; uncorrelated output is not completion evidence.

How to fix it

  • _inspect_job rejected Gateway logs/state whose job_id differs, whose text is not a string, or whose state is unsupported. Reconnect to the intended Gateway node and run manage_job inspect or reconcile on the original job_id; do not treat uncorrelated logs or state as evidence for this job, or relaunch the job to repair a response.
  • Reconnect to the intended Gateway and inspect the authoritative job identity/state. Do not treat uncorrelated logs or state as evidence for this job, or relaunch the job to repair a response.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • A valid correlated observation is obtained for the original job without relaunching it.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Job identity, supervision and dispatch/terminal receipts own effect truth. Diagnostics do not launch, cancel or replay work; missing output or failed control does not prove that the original process stopped.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
